name: Homayoun Shajarian
description: The singer at the centre of the film. Dark wavy hair, heavy brows, close beard.

name: Studio Control Room
description: Control room of the recording studio, console facing the glass onto the live room. Warm lamps, period fittings.

name: Studio Vocal Booth
description: The vocal booth behind the glass, acoustic cloth walls, mic and music desk.

name: Mixing Console
description: The studio mixing desk, long row of faders and channel strips under lit meters.

name: Audio Level Meter
description: Single analogue VU meter in the outboard rack, red scale and needle.

name: Recording Indicator Light
description: The red REC dome that lights when tape is rolling.

name: Studio Headphones
description: Closed-back headphones with coiled cable, hanging on the mic stand.

name: Printed Lyric Page
description: A printed Persian lyric page held open at the music desk.

name: Mohammad-Reza Shajarian
description: Father of Homayoun Shajarian. Older man, grey swept-back hair, thin wire glasses, charcoal suit, light blue shirt, red patterned tie.

name: Sheet Music
description: Printed piano score with Persian lyrics under the staff, titled Mitravad Mahtab, on cream paper.

name: Musician
description: Middle-aged man, long dark hair, full greying beard, denim shirt and jeans.

name: Homayoun Shajarian Voice
description: Homayoun Shajarian singing two couplets (beyt). Reference for his singing voice.
